RELEVANT WORK EXPERIENCE

Data Analytics Manager | Baker McKenzie

July 2025 - Present | Madrid

Serve as process lead and a key contributor to business intelligence analytics and global reporting, supporting critical financial and operational decisions, and coaching and mentoring team members.
Establish and uphold best practices in data visualisation, modelling, documentation, validation, and user experience to strengthen trust in analytics and support firmwide reporting solutions.
Deliver compelling executive-level visual and narrated analyses for global leadership, synthesising complex data to identify key drivers, anomalies, and emerging patterns in operational and financial performance, and translating the findings into clear insights and recommendations.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define data requirements, develop and refine performance metrics, optimise data flows, implement security controls, and ensure analytical outputs align with business objectives.
Transform core analytical data flows from manual extraction to automated pipelines, improving consistency and saving over 300 hours annually by eliminating repetitive tasks.


Business Intelligence Analyst | Baker McKenzie

April 2019 – June 2025 | Madrid

Conducted exploratory and diagnostic analyses to identify trends, anomalies, and performance drivers, translating complex quantitative data into clear visual narratives for diverse audiences to inform decisions at all levels.
Led full analytical project lifecycles, translating ambiguous business questions into structured problems and delivering clear, validated solutions while ensuring usability and stakeholder alignment. For example, developed interactive client-facing dashboards that contributed to successful client pitches across multiple countries.
Designed, built, and maintained a comprehensive suite of over 80 automated, interactive dashboards sourced from multiple systems, providing near-real-time visibility into operational and financial KPIs for more than 2,600 users across locations and functions, while ensuring reliability and adherence to data-quality and visual standards. For example, developed a self-service tool that reduced the time to submit attorney work for billing by 40% in two months, improving billing efficiency and shortening the cash cycle.

June 2015 – April 2019 | Moscow

Led monthly, quarterly, and annual management reporting, analysing variances and consolidating data to provide senior stakeholders with accurate, timely insights into financial performance.
Effectively managed core finance processes, including month- and year-end close, budget management, and annual planning.

This helped understand customer perceptions, identify potential issues, and discover opportunities for improvement and innovation. Presented the insights through clear, engaging visualisations, and communicated the business implications and practical recommendations in a clear, accessible way for a non-technical audience, supporting business growth and improving marketing effectiveness.

title: Yulia Lopatina
text:
Data analyst with 10+ years in finance and operations, translating complex data into insights that drive measurable outcomes. My work has contributed to $145M+ in business impact, driving revenue, operational efficiency, and client growth.
I hold an MSc in Business Analytics from the University of Bath, a leading UK business school, and work across the full analytical spectrum — time-series forecasting, machine learning, NLP, regression, clustering, simulation, optimisation, and data visualisation. Whether building a personal dashboard or synthesising business data for executives, I ensure clear problem definition, rigorous analysis, and clear communication.
Languages & libraries: Python (pandas, numpy, seaborn, matplotlib, statsmodels, sklearn, transformers), R (tidyverse, dplyr, ggplot2), SQL.
Productivity & data tools: Excel (VBA, Power Query, Solver), Microsoft 365, Markdown, Git.
BI & analytics platforms: Tableau, Power BI, IBM Cognos Analytics, SAP Business Objects, Dataiku, Copilot Studio.

title: Yulia Lopatina
text:
I am an experienced Data Analyst with over 10 years in finance and operations within a multinational environment, backed by a solid academic foundation in Business Analytics from the University of Bath (UK), focused on generating and applying data insights across diverse business contexts. I have a proven track record of delivering data-driven solutions that enhance business performance.
Passionate about data, I develop analytical solutions to bring clarity to complexity, whether for a personal problem, such as creating a workout-tracker dashboard to support decision-making on workload and performance optimisation, or in a professional context, where I synthesise complex data to identify key drivers, anomalies, and patterns in operational and financial performance. My experience includes time-series forecasting, machine learning, NLP, regression analysis, clustering, simulation, optimisation, data visualisation, and AI agents.
My tech stack includes Python (pandas, numpy, seaborn, matplotlib, statsmodels, sklearn, transformers), R (tidyverse, dplyr, ggplot2), SQL, Excel (VBA, Power Query, Data Analysis, Solver), Markdown, Git, IBM Cognos Analytics, SAP Business Objects, Dataiku, Power BI, Tableau, and Copilot Studio.

title: Simulation-Driven Capacity and Cost Optimisation
text: By simulating ABC Co.’s manufacturing process, I identified bottlenecks and quantified the financial impact of manufacturing delays. By modelling alternative capacity scenarios, I provided data-driven recommendations that improve operational efficiency and reduce operational costs.

title: Arabica Coffee Quality
text: This interactive dashboard evaluates Arabica coffee quality through a product analytics lens, using regression-based insights to identify the key drivers of overall grade. The analysis supports data-driven decisions in quality control, sourcing, pricing strategy, and product positioning, demonstrating how analytics can directly inform business value.

title: Forecasting Unemployment in Canada
text: In this project, I analysed and predicted quarterly unemployment trends in Canada using time series forecasting models to support labour market analysis and policy-relevant decision-making.

title: Predicting Mobile Game Ratings
text: Using machine learning, I identified the key drivers of user satisfaction and engagement in mobile strategy games. The analysis revealed patterns behind positive reviews, providing actionable insights to inform game design, marketing strategy, and product development.

title: Workout Performance Tracker
text: This interactive dashboard transforms activity and performance data into actionable insights for workload planning, performance optimisation, and risk management. Inspired by the Apple Watch interface, it combines an intuitive design with analytical methods to monitor key performance drivers, detect risk patterns, and enable data-driven optimisation of training and recovery strategies.

title: Improving E-commerce Customer Experience with NLP
text: By analysing Amazon reviews and evaluating customer sentiment and emotions towards products, services, and brands, I identified the main factors associated with customer satisfaction and uncovered meaningful customer segments. This enabled a better understanding of customer perceptions, detection of issues, rapid response to positive or negative trends, and the identification of opportunities for improvement or innovation. I offered data-driven recommendations to improve product quality, meet customer expectations, and mitigate reputational and revenue risks in e-commerce.
